cue: A proof infers a polynomial variance saving using only small first Gaussian chaos and bounded-degree directed path structure.
fire_when: An agent promotes Var(Pi_1 F)=O(1), coordinate gradients<=1 and bounded outdegree into Var(F)=O(L^(1-epsilon)) without bounding the remaining chaoses.
silent_when: The proof gives an independently justified bound for the higher chaoses/noise overlap, or explicitly records that estimate as the remaining gap.
text: Small first Gaussian chaos leaves the higher chaoses uncontrolled. A binary-tree-plus-chains Gaussian polymer has first-chaos variance <3 but total variance Theta(L/log L). Identify the lattice-specific bound before claiming a power gain.
